description: Three light-blue bowls sit on a dark cloth-covered surface in front of a pale pillow propped upright. The left hand reaches forward to the nearest bowl, lifts it, and places it on top of the bowl to the right to form a stack; then the left hand goes back to the remaining bowl, lifts it, and sets it onto the same stack, leaving the bowls neatly nested while the right hand stays out of contact.
